name: generate_illustration
description: Start one AI-generated visual analogy (fal) shown to the student and saved locally with the current lesson step, session and lecture slide. Use simple concrete scenes and everyday analogies; never request text, labels, formulas, molecules or diagrams. Returns immediately once started; a later contextual update reports whether it was displayed or failed. You cannot see the result.

subject.description: A concrete scene to illustrate, 3–600 characters, for example: a small glowing orb handed from a battery to a hexagonal glass tile like a relay baton.

kind.description: image (default). video only when the app reports a video model; it can take minutes.
